policy: Preserve historical collection methods and data; add new modules rather than replacing or deleting old ones.
preservation_rules: Completed research modules remain in-tree with enabled=false or manual trigger.
Dangerous/buggy historical implementations are retained only as .disabled.txt snapshots.
Previously extracted reference data remains build-pinned and read-only.
No legacy snapshot may be auto-loaded by scripts/main.lua or ModuleHost.
Future removals require an explicit replacement/archive record.
New research routes should be added as separate modules when practical.
Treasure discovery and future validator remain separate modules; completed or superseded versions are disabled/archived rather than deleted.
The 1.0.38 Treasure archive preserves source, catalogs, and reports while excluding all Treasure modules from the active probe order.
The 1.0.39 Assault trigger archive preserves transition evidence while excluding CUnexpectedMissionInStandAlone polling from the active runtime.
